I have farmed this small plot for many years, and at my age I know what the land needs without buying expensive chemicals from the cooperative. I will spread the cow dung and compost I have saved over this quarter-hectare piece, but I cannot afford to buy DAP or urea for such a small plot when my family has other costs to consider. My daughters and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, as we have always done.
